annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses preserve the same decision-relevant evidence for technical investigation. Each cites appropriate technical sources beyond app logs (traces, service metrics, change history, dependency health, DNS/certificates or similar), proposes distinguishing checks such as clustering by instance/region/path and testing correlation with deployments or nodes, and interprets the pattern as suggesting a narrower routing/dependency/app-timeout issue rather than a broad infrastructure outage. Response A is more detailed, but B and C retain the same criterion-level commitments without introducing contradictions or omitting any material diagnostic approach.
